questions.question: 7 qatlamli OSI modeli va DevOps muhandisi har kuni ishlaydigan qatlamlarni tushuntiring.
questions.explanation: Application (L7): HTTP, DNS, gRPC, SSH (Ingress, API Gateway).

questions.question: TCP va UDP'ni ulanish holati, ishonchlilik, header va qo'llanilish bo'yicha solishtiring.
questions.explanation: TCP:

questions.question: `api.stripe.com` ga kirishda DNS resolution'ning to'liq yo'lini tushuntiring.
questions.explanation: Lokal cache: brauzer → OS resolver (/etc/hosts, systemd-resolved) cache.

questions.question: Public IP, private IP (RFC 1918) va NAT farqi.
questions.explanation: Public IP: global noyob, internetda bevosita marshrutlanadi.

questions.question: CIDR yozuvi va subnet hajmini hisoblashni tushuntiring.
questions.explanation: CIDR — bazaviy IP va prefiks uzunligi (/XX — tarmoq qismi bitlari):

questions.question: TLS 1.3 handshake'ini tushuntiring va TLS 1.2 bilan solishtiring.
questions.explanation: TLS 1.2 (2-RTT): cipher kelishuvi va kalit almashinuvi uchun ikki to'liq round-trip.

questions.question: Simmetrik va asimmetrik shifrlash farqi.
questions.explanation: Asimmetrik (RSA, ECC): public/private kalit jufti; sekin — raqamli imzo va kalit almashinuvi uchun.

questions.question: Reverse proxy va forward proxy farqi.
questions.explanation: Forward proxy: client'lar oldida — chiquvchi trafikni tekshiradi, filtrlaydi yoki anonimlashtiradi (korporativ proxy).

questions.question: Web Application Firewall (WAF) nima?
questions.explanation: HTTP/HTTPS trafikni tekshirib OWASP Top 10 hujumlarini (SQLi, XSS, zararli bot, rate flood) bloklaydigan L7 xavfsizlik vositasi. Ilova kodidagi zaifliklarni tuzatish o'rnini bosmaydi.

questions.question: Zero Trust arxitekturasi nima?
questions.explanation: "Hech qachon ishonma, doim tekshir" modeli: ishonchli ichki tarmoq tushunchasi yo'q — har so'rov qayerdan kelishidan qat'i nazar autentifikatsiya, avtorizatsiya qilinadi va shifrlanadi (mTLS).

questions.question: Mutual TLS (mTLS) nima?
questions.explanation: Oddiy TLS faqat serverni client'ga tasdiqlaydi. mTLS da client va server bir-biriga X.509 sertifikat ko'rsatadi — ikki tomonlama shifrlash va kriptografik identity tekshiruvi (service mesh'da avtomatik).

questions.question: DevSecOps va "Shift-Left" falsafasi nima?
questions.explanation: Xavfsizlik nazoratlari, zaiflik testlari va compliance guardrail'larini prod oldidagi yakuniy tekshiruv emas, birinchi commit'dan boshlab pipeline'ga integratsiya qilish.

questions.question: SAST, DAST, IAST va SCA farqi.
questions.explanation: SAST: compile'dan oldin source kodni skanerlash (Semgrep, SonarQube).

questions.question: HashiCorp Vault va uning asosiy imkoniyatlari nima?
questions.explanation: Identity asosidagi secret boshqaruvi: statik va dynamic secret'lar, avtomatik rotatsiya, TTL va revocation, encryption as a service (Transit), dinamik PKI sertifikatlar; audit log.

questions.question: CVE va CVSS ball nima?
questions.explanation: CVE: ommaga ma'lum zaiflikning standart identifikatori (CVE-2021-44228 — Log4Shell).

questions.question: Kubernetes RBAC'ni (xavfsizlik kontekstida) tushuntiring.
questions.explanation: Role / ClusterRole: resurslar (pods, secrets) ustida fe'llar (get, list, create) — namespace yoki klaster doirasida.

questions.question: Bastion host va SSM Session Manager farqi.
questions.explanation: Bastion: public subnet'dagi, 22-port ochiq va SSH kalit boshqaruvi talab qiladigan instance.

questions.question: DDoS nima va edge'da qanday kamaytiriladi?
questions.explanation: Taqsimlangan botnet bilan servisni ishdan chiqarishga qaratilgan toshqin. Cloudflare/AWS Shield, Anycast, edge cache, rate limiting va WAF qoidalari bilan.

questions.question: Container escape (xavfsizlik kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: Container ichidagi hujumchi kernel zaifligi yoki noto'g'ri huquqdan (--privileged, root, host mount) foydalanib namespace'dan chiqib host ustidan root nazoratini olishi.

questions.question: Git'da secret scanning va CI'da secret masking nima?
questions.explanation: Secret scanning (Gitleaks, Trufflehog): commit diff'larida AWS kalit, SSH private key, API token pattern'larini topib push'ni bloklaydi.

questions.question: Kubernetes default-deny NetworkPolicy yozing va whitelisting qanday ishlashini tushuntiring.
questions.explanation: apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1

questions.question: Cilium NetworkPolicy nima va L7 xavfsizlikni qanday beradi?
questions.explanation: Oddiy NetworkPolicy faqat IP va port (L3/L4) bo'yicha filtrlaydi.

questions.question: SPIFFE/SPIRE va workload identity attestation qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: SPIFFE standart identity beradi (spiffe://prod.example.com/ns/finance/sa/payment-service).

questions.question: Vault dynamic secrets statik DB credential'larini qanday yo'qotadi?
questions.explanation: Ilova Vault'ga Kubernetes ServiceAccount token'i bilan autentifikatsiya qiladi.

questions.question: External Secrets Operator (xavfsizlik kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: Tashqi secret manager'lardan nativ Secret ga sinxronlaydi — GitOps repo'ga faqat deklarativ ExternalSecret manifesti commit qilinadi, ochiq qiymat Git'ga tushmaydi.

questions.question: Admission control uchun OPA Gatekeeper va Kyverno solishtiring.
questions.explanation: Gatekeeper: Rego tili — juda ifodali, lekin o'rganish qiyin; Kubernetes'dan tashqarida ham OPA ishlatiladi.

questions.question: CycloneDX va SPDX SBOM formatlari farqi.
questions.explanation: CycloneDX (OWASP): yengil, application security, zaiflik aniqlash va CI/CD avtomatlashtirish uchun (VEX qo'llovi).

questions.question: Cosign va keyless image imzolash (xavfsizlik kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: Image GitHub Actions OIDC token'i bilan imzolanadi: Fulcio qisqa muddatli X.509 beradi, Rekor imzoni o'zgarmas transparency log'ga yozadi — statik private kalit yo'q.

questions.question: Falco Kubernetes'da runtime tahdidlarni qanday aniqlaydi?
questions.explanation: eBPF orqali syscall'larni tahlil qilib shubhali xulqda darhol alert beradi: prod'da /bin/bash ochilishi, /etc/shadow o'zgarishi, ruxsatsiz chiquvchi ulanish.

questions.question: BGP routing va Anycast farqi.
questions.explanation: BGP: autonom tizimlar (AS) orasida erishiluvchanlik ma'lumotini almashadigan internetning asosiy routing protokoli.

questions.question: HTTP/3 (QUIC) nima va nega HTTP/2 dan yaxshiroq?
questions.explanation: HTTP/2 (TCP): stream'lar multiplekslangan, lekin TCP darajasida head-of-line blocking — bitta paket yo'qolsa hamma stream kutadi.

questions.question: KMS envelope encryption (xavfsizlik kontekstida) qanday?
questions.explanation: KMS kaliti plaintext DEK va shifrlangan DEK yaratadi.

questions.question: CIS Benchmark nima va Kubernetes'da qanday majburlanadi?
questions.explanation: Center for Internet Security'ning control plane, worker node va etcd xavfsizligi uchun aniq hardening qoidalari; kube-bench bilan avtomatik tekshiriladi, natijalar CI/monitoringga ulanadi.

questions.question: Zero-day zaiflik nima va defense in depth uni qanday kamaytiradi?
questions.explanation: Patch chiqmasdan oldin faol exploit qilinayotgan kamchilik. Qatlamli himoya: runtime anomaliya aniqlash (Falco), qat'iy egress NetworkPolicy (reverse shell/C2 bloklanadi), non-root va read-only container, least privil...

questions.question: DNSSEC nima?
questions.explanation: DNS yozuvlariga kriptografik imzo qo'shib, DNS spoofing, cache poisoning va MITM'dan himoya qiladi (shifrlamaydi — maxfiylik uchun DoH/DoT).

questions.question: SQL injection va XSS farqi.
questions.explanation: SQLi: input orqali SQL bo'laklarini kiritib so'rovni o'zgartirish — prepared statement / parametrlangan so'rov bilan oldi olinadi.

questions.question: PKI va Certificate Authority (CA) nima?
questions.explanation: PKI — raqamli sertifikatlarni boshqaruvchi infratuzilma. CA — identity'ni tasdiqlab imzolangan X.509 sertifikat beradigan ishonchli tomon (Let's Encrypt, DigiCert, Vault CA). Ishonch zanjiri: root → intermediate → leaf.

questions.question: GuardDuty va Security Hub farqi.
questions.explanation: GuardDuty: CloudTrail, Flow Logs, EKS audit log'larini ML bilan tahlil qiluvchi tahdid aniqlash.

questions.question: Trivy qaysi artifact turlarini skanerlaydi?
questions.explanation: Container image, Git repo, fayl tizimi, IaC (Terraform, Helm, Dockerfile) va jonli Kubernetes klasterlarini CVE, misconfiguration, secret va litsenziya bo'yicha.

questions.question: SSL termination va end-to-end encryption farqi.
questions.explanation: Termination: load balancer HTTPS'ni ochib, backend'ga shifrlanmagan HTTP yuboradi.

questions.question: ARP va ARP poisoning nima?
questions.explanation: ARP lokal segmentda L3 IP'ni L2 MAC'ga map qiladi. Poisoning — hujumchi soxta ARP javoblari bilan o'z MAC'ini legitim IP'ga (gateway) bog'lab MITM qiladi. Himoya: dynamic ARP inspection, statik yozuvlar, shifrlash.

questions.question: MTU va Path MTU Discovery (PMTUD) nima?
questions.explanation: MTU — tarmoqda uzatiladigan maksimal paket hajmi (Ethernet 1500, jumbo frame 9000). PMTUD yo'l bo'ylab minimal MTU'ni ICMP orqali aniqlab, fragmentatsiyaning oldini oladi (ICMP bloklansa ishlamaydi).

questions.question: TCP SYN flood va SYN cookies nima?
questions.explanation: Hujumchi yakuniy ACK yubormasdan SYN toshqini bilan half-open ulanishlar jadvalini to'ldiradi. SYN cookies holatni SYN-ACK sequence raqamiga kodlaydi — haqiqiy ACK kelguncha xotira ajratilmaydi.

questions.question: DHCP nima?
questions.explanation: Lokal tarmoqdagi qurilmalarga IP, subnet mask, default gateway va DNS server manzillarini dinamik beradigan protokol (DORA: Discover, Offer, Request, Ack).

questions.question: VLAN nima?
questions.explanation: Fizik switch'lar bo'ylab L2 da yaratilgan mantiqiy broadcast domen — umumiy kabelda bo'limlar yoki tenant'lar trafigini ajratadi.

questions.question: BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) nima?
questions.explanation: Autonom tizimlar orasida path-vector algoritmi bilan routing va erishiluvchanlik ma'lumotini almashadigan internetning asosiy protokoli (BGP hijack/leak — global avariyalar sababi).

questions.question: ICMP nima?
questions.explanation: Tarmoq qurilmalari xato va operatsion ma'lumot yuboradigan L3 protokol (ping — Echo Request/Reply; traceroute — Time Exceeded). ICMP'ni butunlay bloklash PMTUD'ni buzadi.

questions.question: Subnet mask va default gateway nima?
questions.explanation: Subnet mask: IP'ning qaysi qismi tarmoq, qaysi qismi host (255.255.255.0 = /24).

questions.question: DNS `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME` va `ALIAS` yozuvlari farqi.
questions.explanation: A: hostname → IPv4.

questions.question: DNS TTL nima?
questions.explanation: Resolver va client'lar yozuvni authoritative serverni qayta so'ramasdan cache'lashi mumkin bo'lgan soniyalar. Migratsiyadan oldin TTL'ni kamaytiring — aks holda eski IP uzoq cache'da qoladi.

questions.question: OIDC va OAuth 2.0 (xavfsizlik kontekstida) farqi.
questions.explanation: OAuth 2.0: avtorizatsiya framework'i — API kirishi uchun access token.

questions.question: SAML 2.0 nima?
questions.explanation: IdP va Service Provider orasida autentifikatsiya/avtorizatsiya ma'lumotlarini almashish uchun XML asosidagi standart — korporativ SSO'da keng tarqalgan.

questions.question: JWT tuzilishi (xavfsizlik kontekstida) qanday?
questions.explanation: Nuqta bilan ajratilgan uch Base64URL qism: Header (algoritm), Payload (sub, exp, iss claim'lari), Signature (HMAC/RSA/ECDSA). Tekshirishda alg ni server o'zi belgilashi kerak (alg: none hujumi), exp, aud, iss majburiy...

questions.question: Vault Transit secrets engine nima?
questions.explanation: "Cryptography as a Service": ilova ma'lumotni API orqali shifrlaydi/ochadi, kalitlar ilova serverida saqlanmaydi (kalit rotatsiyasi va rewrap qo'llanadi).

questions.question: Vault PKI secrets engine nima?
questions.explanation: Talab bo'yicha qisqa muddatli (masalan 24 soatlik) X.509 TLS sertifikatlarini dinamik chiqaradi — ichki CA operatsiyalari avtomatlashadi.

questions.question: Kyverno mutation qoidasi nima?
questions.explanation: Yaratilishda manifestga default maydonlarni avtomatik qo'shadi yoki o'zgartiradi (resource request, label, securityContext).

questions.question: OPA Rego tili nima?
questions.explanation: JSON/YAML ma'lumotlar ustida murakkab strukturaviy va semantik compliance siyosatlarini ifodalash uchun deklarativ so'rov tili.

questions.question: Trivy secret scanning nima?
questions.explanation: CI paytida image layer'lari va Git fayl tizimida ochiq qolgan private kalit, AWS va Slack token'larini qidiradi.

questions.question: Gitleaks pre-commit hook nima?
questions.explanation: Staged fayllarda yuqori entropiyali secret yoki token topilsa lokal git commit ni bloklaydi.

questions.question: Trufflehog nima?
questions.explanation: Git repo, S3 va fayl tizimlarida ochiq secret'larni qidiradigan va topilgan kalitlar cloud API'larda hali ham faol ekanini tekshiradigan (verification) ochiq tool.
